automation.windows_task_scheduler: schtasks /Create /SC MONTHLY /D 15 /TN USAspendingRefresh /TR "cmd /c cd C:\Users\Peter-HP\git\anyfeddemo && python scripts\usaspending_coverage.py fill && python scripts\usaspending_duck.py build && python scripts\usaspending_duck.py gold --agency 097 --fy 2026"
